connector.name: Gatekeeper
connector.registryDescription: Run MCP tool calls through Runestone Gatekeeper - policy enforcement, human approval, audit.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package gatekeeper-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the runestone-labs account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: GATEKEEPER_ROLE
env.description: Policy role this server presents to Gatekeeper for every call. Required.

env.name: GATEKEEPER_URL
env.description: Base URL of the Gatekeeper server. Default http://127.0.0.1:3847.

env.name: GATEKEEPER_AGENT_NAME
env.description: Agent name recorded in Gatekeeper audit logs. Default mcp-client.

env.name: GATEKEEPER_RUN_ID
env.description: Optional run-correlation id so calls count toward one per-run budget.
